k:暖.mnemonic: The day (日) sun pours through the window onto your lap, where your friend (友) the cat kneads the blanket with one claw (爪) and purrs. Warmth.
k:暖.hint: Sun, lap, and a kneading cat.

k:括.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) wind an old (古) rope around the bundle, and the tongue (舌) pokes out with the effort of pulling the knot tight. Fasten (tie up, arrest, constrict).

k:籠.mnemonic: Bamboo (竹) strips are woven for a month (月) until the thing can stand (立) on its own, big enough to carry a dragon home from market. Basket (devote oneself, seclude oneself, cage).

k:牲.mnemonic: A cow (牛) is led to the shrine with ribbons on its horns. Its life (生) is what the village gives to the gods. Animal sacrifice (offering).

k:悩.mnemonic: Your heartbeat (忄) races: the sparkle (⺌) you were chasing has rolled down into a pit (凵) with a big X at the bottom, and you cannot stop fretting about it. Trouble (worry, in pain, distress).
k:悩.hint: Treasure lost down a marked pit.

k:荘.mnemonic: A retired samurai (士) builds a country house with plank (爿) walls and lets flowers (艹) grow all over the roof. Villa (inn, cottage, feudal manor).

k:拾.mnemonic: You spot a lost glove on the road. It would suit (合) the lone one in your pocket, so your fingers (扌) reach down for it. Pick up (gather, find, go on foot).
k:拾.hint: A glove found on the road.

k:獄.mnemonic: A hound (犭) on one side, a dog (犬) on the other, and between them a man who can say (言) whatever he likes: he is not getting out. Prison (jail).
k:獄.hint: A man between two guard dogs.

k:紛.mnemonic: The thread (糸) you were following splits, and one part (分) wanders off sideways. Your eye goes after the wrong strand and you lose your place. Distract (be mistaken for, go astray, divert).

k:婆.mnemonic: She has seen a tsunami (氵) come and go, outlived the guy (奴) she married, and sits by the fire with an ancient pelt (皮) around her shoulders. Old woman (grandma, wet nurse).
k:婆.hint: By the fire in a pelt.

k:覆.mnemonic: A stroll (彳) by boat on a fine day (日), until the west (西) wind flips it upside down and you trudge (夂) home dripping. Capsize (cover, shade, mantle).

k:勘.mnemonic: Without opening the crate (匚), she knows that something sweet (甘) is inside. That knowing is her power (力), and her legs (儿) are already carrying her toward it. Intuition (perception, check, compare).

k:叔.mnemonic: He is father's little brother, and also (又) the one who lets the small (小) children play with his divining rod (卜) while father is not looking. Uncle (youth).
k:叔.hint: He lends the kids his rod.

k:巣.mnemonic: In a tree (木) beside the rice field (田), three little heads with a sparkle (⺌) in their eyes poke up over the rim, beaks open for worms. Nest (rookery, hive, cobweb).
k:巣.hint: Three chicks peeping from a tree.

k:洞.mnemonic: The tsunami (氵) hit the same (同) spot of cliff again and again until it hollowed it out. Now a bear sleeps in the hole. Den (cave, excavation).
k:洞.hint: Waves hollowed out a bear's home.

k:菓.mnemonic: Fruit from the tree (木), sugared and shaped into little flowers (艹), is sold from a stall beside the rice field (田). Candy (cakes, fruit).

k:匠.mnemonic: An axe (斤) kept in its own fitted crate (匚). Only someone who lives by his tools looks after them like that. Artisan (workman, carpenter).

k:漏.mnemonic: A flag (尸) is stretched out as a roof, but the rain (雨) gets in underneath, and soon a small tsunami (氵) is dripping through onto the floor. Leak (escape, time, hour).
k:漏.hint: Rain dripping through a flag roof.

k:吐.mnemonic: He trips in the garden and gets a mouth (口) full of soil (土). Out it comes again at once, with a splutter. Spit (vomit, belch, confess).
k:吐.hint: A mouthful of dirt, spluttered out.

k:刃.mnemonic: A sword (刀) with a single drop (丶) clinging to it, marking exactly the part that does the cutting. Blade (sword, edge).

k:垂.mnemonic: A willow: one (一) crossbar on a stick (｜) of trunk, and from it layer after layer of branches slide (ノ) down until the tips brush the ground. Droop (suspend, hang, slouch).

k:哀.mnemonic: A mouth (口) buried in a garment (衣): someone sobbing into their own sleeve so that nobody will hear. Pathetic (grief, sorrow, pathos).

k:宜.mnemonic: A letter that closes by wishing well to everyone under your roof (宀), with a kindly eye (目) drawn beside the signature. Best regards (good).
k:宜.hint: A warm sign-off to the household.

k:尺.mnemonic: A flag (尸) pole laid flat on the workbench, with a drop (丶) of ink marking off each length of about a foot: the carpenter's ruler. Shaku (Japanese foot, measure, scale).

k:歓.mnemonic: Tonight the archers lack (欠) nothing. One arrow (矢) brought down a fat turkey (隹), and the whole camp cheers around the fire as it roasts. Delight (joy).

k:媛.mnemonic: A guy (奴) bows low and holds out a flower on the tip of one claw (爪). He would do anything for the princess who just walked by. Beautiful woman (princess).
k:媛.hint: He bows and offers a flower.

k:恒.mnemonic: A heartbeat (忄) as regular as dawn (旦). The sun rises between heaven and earth every single day and has never once missed. Constancy (always).

k:倫.mnemonic: The leader (亻) opens the heavy tome (冊) of right and wrong and asks his students: what should a person do, right now (今)? Ethics (companion).
k:倫.hint: The big book of right and wrong.

k:傘.mnemonic: One enormous hat (𠆢) on a pole shaped like ten (十), and every person (人) in the group crowds in underneath to stay dry. Umbrella.
k:傘.hint: Everyone huddled under one big hat.

k:克.mnemonic: Old (古) legs (儿) that still make it to the top of the hill, one stubborn step at a time. Overcome (kindly, skillfully).
